अरे यारों, रामायण के गानों को लेकर आ गया है एकदम मसालेदार अपडेट! 🎬

लिरिसिस्ट डॉ कुमार विश्वास ने शेयर किया है एक शानदार BTS वीडियो, जिसमें ए आर रहमान और श्रेया घोषाल के साथ पूरी टीम नजर आ रही है। 🎵

डायरेक्टर नितेश तिवारी की इस फिल्म में रणबीर कपूर (भगवान राम), साई पल्लवी (सीता), और यश (रावण) लीड रोल में हैं, जबकि सनी देओल हनुमान और रवि दुबे लक्ष्मण बने हैं। 🤩

कुमार विश्वास का कहना है कि भगवान ने खुद उन्हें इस सफर के लिए चुना है और यह उनके लिए सिर्फ एक फिल्म नहीं बल्कि श्री राम की भक्ति का आशीर्वाद है। 🙏

रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक 4,000 करोड़ रुपये के भारी-भरकम बजट में बनी यह फिल्म दो पार्ट्स में आएगी, जिसका पहला भाग 5 नवंबर 2026 को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होगा और दूसरा भाग दिवाली 2028 पर आएगा। 💸

तो आपको क्या लगता है, 4,000 करोड़ के बजट वाली यह फिल्म बॉक्स ऑफिस पर कौन-कौन से रिकॉर्ड तोड़ेगी? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Kumar Vishwas calls writing lyrics for Ramayana a divine experience, shares BTS video with AR Rahman and Shreya Ghoshal
ctx.summary: Dr Kumar Vishwas thanked viewers for embracing the songs of Ramayana and engaging with the lyrics in a meaningful way.
ctx.text:
Ramayana has been receiving praise from viewers ever since it released in theatres ahead of Diwali. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the film stars Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi and Yash in the lead roles. The film's lyricist, Dr Kumar Vishwas, has now penned a heartfelt note on the journey of being part of the process from the very beginning. He said that Ramayana felt as if God chose him for this journey.
The lyricist has written for all the songs that were composed by AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer. He shared a BTS video where the team was present inside the studio to collaborate on the songs and find the correct tune for each and every part. It showed the hours of dedication and hard work that went into creating the songs. Namit Malhotra, Nitesh Tiwari, Shreya Ghoshal and Vishal Dadlani were also seen in the BTS footage.
In the caption, Kumar wrote, “Sometimes, I believe God chooses you for certain journeys Himself. Ramayana has never been just a film for me. I believe it is the blessing of all these years of devotion, faith, and surrender to Shri Ram. Thank you, Bhagwan Ram for choosing me to be a small part of something so extraordinary. What an experience it has been to work alongside some of the greatest creative minds of our time, to witness this vision come alive, and above all, to see the love with which you all have embraced my words.”
He thanked the makers and concluded, “To see you all not just listen to my lyrics, but feel them and understand even their deepest meanings, is a blessing beyond words.Some journeys are not planned. They are written for you by the divine. Jai Siya Ram.”
Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana is a two-part cinematic adaptation of the ancient Indian epic. Ramayana is one of the world's oldest pieces of literature. It tells the story of Lord Rama, the incarnation of Lord Vishnu (played by Ranbir Kapoor), and his battle against the asura king Ravana (played by Yash) after the latter abducts his wife, Sita (played by Sai Pallavi). The cast also includes Sunny Deol as Hanuman and Ravi Dubey as Lakshman. The film is produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash, with music by AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer.
Reportedly mounted on a budget of ₹ 4,000 crore, the film is backed by Yash and Namit Malhotra and is planned as a two-part franchise. The first instalment is scheduled to release in theatres on November 5, 2026, with the second part expected to arrive around Diwali 2028.
Santanu Das is a Senior Content Producer at Hindustan Times with over 5 years of experience, writing on films, pop culture and film festivals. He has a keen interest in writing about South Asian independent films and has covered several film festivals, including Sundance and CPH: Docx. He also brings a sharp perspective to the monthly column called The Fault in Our Stars, where he writes about a recent film/series and what stops the ‘good’ from becoming ‘great’.

A gold medalist from Banaras Hindu University, Santanu completed his postgraduate studies in English from Jadavpur University. He is also a Rotten Tomatoes-certified film critic. When not watching films or speaking to celebrities, Santanu can be found reading a book. Some of his favourite films are Aparajito, Ponyo and The Double Life of Veronique. His favourite books include The Corrections, The God of Small Things and A Room of One's Own.

Santanu continues to write passionately about films and celebrity culture. He brings a relatable, as well as critically informed, lens to entertainment and culture for a wide audience.
